projectDescription: A minimal Node.js Hello World app that demonstrates the Zoom OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow, exchanging credentials for an access token and calling the Zoom API.
keyFeatures: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with Zoom
Minimal Node.js HTTP server with zero runtime dependencies
Automatic redirect to Zoom authorization page
Access token exchange from authorization code
Calls Zoom API /v2/users/me to retrieve user profile
ngrok integration for local development redirect URL
publicApiSurface: GET / — redirects to Zoom OAuth authorize URL
GET /?code=<auth_code> — exchanges code for access token and returns user profile
ENV: CLIENT_ID — Zoom OAuth app client ID
ENV: CLIENT_SECRET — Zoom OAuth app client secret
ENV: REDIRECT_URL — OAuth redirect URI (ngrok URL in development)
